About JR Hospital

A neighbourhood hospital built around always being open

Ja-Ela Ragama Hospitals (Pvt) Ltd, known locally as JR Hospital – Ja-Ela, serves patients from Ja-Ela and the surrounding area on Negombo Road. Outpatient care, pharmacy, laboratory and emergency treatment run continuously, with consultant clinics, diagnostics and inward care alongside them.

  • Emergency Treatment Unit and ambulance service
  • Fully air-conditioned admission rooms for inward patients
  • Home nursing visits and counselling support
More about the hospital

Key Facilities

Everything a first visit usually needs, on one site

All 23 facilities

  • Emergency Treatment

    Immediate care, any hour of the day or night.

  • Digital X-Ray

    Fast digital imaging with same-visit results.

  • Ultrasound

    General and obstetric scanning on site.

  • Laboratory

    Round-the-clock testing and reporting.

  • Eye Clinic

    Examinations and cataract surgery.

  • Pharmacy

    Prescribed medicines dispensed 24 hours.

Specialist Consultation Services

Consultant-led sessions run alongside our daily OPD — including eye care and cataract surgery, dental treatment, physiotherapy, audiology, speech and language therapy, and counselling.
